fato_historico: 1949: In Ecuador, an earthquake destroys 50 towns and kills more than 6,000.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to find strength in your foundations, Taurus. Much like the earth itself that occasionally shifts and demands a rebuild, you may feel an urge to fortify your spirit today. Consider this a time to cherish the stability you have built, offering compassion and hope to those who might be navigating their own sudden transformations.
frase_do_dia: Deep roots allow you to weather any storm with grace and steady courage.
significado_numero: Represents the stability of the four corners of the world.
conselho: Nurture your physical space and honor your emotional boundaries with gentle, intentional care.
